## Delay mean estimates
```{r, echo = FALSE}
pars_summary %>% 
    filter(par == "mean", 
           delay %in% c("onset to case_report", "onset to hospitalisation")) %>%
    select(delay, group, mean, median, q2.5, q97.5)
```


## Number of missing onset dates

```{r, echo = FALSE}
onset_missing <- which(is.na(samples$data$onset))
n_onset_missing_by_group <- table(samples$data$group[onset_missing])
sum(n_onset_missing_by_group)
```

## Number of missing onset dates where date inferred by Garske et al are in 95% Credible Sets
```{r, echo = FALSE}
is_in_credible_set <- 
  unlist(lapply(onset_missing, 
                function(i) data_with_onset_inferred$onset_inferred[i] %in%
                  calc_credible_set(samples, i, 1, 0.95)))
n_in_credible_set_by_group <- 
  table(samples$data$group[onset_missing[is_in_credible_set]])
sum(n_in_credible_set_by_group)
```

### As a percentage of missing onset dates
```{r, echo = FALSE}
sum(n_in_credible_set_by_group) / sum(n_onset_missing_by_group) * 100
```
